tall_man.note: Not listed in FDA/ISMP Tall Man list; generic name lowercase per EXTRACTION.md

refs.quote: Partial seizures with complex symptomatology (psychomotor, temporal lobe).

Adults and children over 12 years of age-Initial: Either 200 mg twice a day for tablets and XR tablets, or 1 teaspoon four times a day for suspension (400 mg/day). Increase at weekly intervals by adding up to 200 mg/day using a twice a day regimen of Tegretol-XR or a three times a day or four times a day regimen of the other formulations until the optimal response is obtained.

regimens.dose_text: Initial: 200 mg orally twice daily (400 mg/day). Increase at weekly intervals by adding up to 200 mg/day until optimal response. Maximum recommended dosage is 1200 mg daily.

refs.quote: Tegretol is indicated in the treatment of the pain associated with true trigeminal neuralgia.

Initial: On the first day, either 100 mg twice a day for tablets or XR tablets, or ½ teaspoon four times a day for suspension, for a total daily dose of 200 mg. This daily dose may be increased by up to 200 mg/day using increments of 100 mg every 12 hours for tablets or XR tablets, or 50 mg (½ teaspoon) four times a day for suspension, only as needed to achieve freedom from pain.

regimens.dose_text: Initial: 100 mg twice daily (total 200 mg/day). Increase by up to 200 mg/day in increments of 100 mg every 12 hours as needed to control pain (maximum 1200 mg daily).

hepatic.value: Liver damage and hepatitis reported; baseline and periodic liver function monitoring required.

value.drug_or_class: CYP3A4 Inhibitors (Macrolides, Azole Antifungals, Diltiazem, Verapamil, Ciprofloxacin, Grapefruit Juice)
value.effect: Inhibition of CYP3A4 reduces carbamazepine clearance, elevating carbamazepine serum concentrations and risking acute neurotoxicity (ataxia, dizziness, diplopia, somnolence).
value.management: Adjust Tegretol dosage and/or monitor serum levels closely when initiating or discontinuing CYP3A4 inhibitors.

refs.quote: CYP3A4 inhibitors inhibit Tegretol metabolism and can thus increase plasma carbamazepine levels.

value.effect: Enzyme induction increases rate of carbamazepine metabolism, causing subtherapeutic levels and seizure breakthrough.
value.management: Monitor carbamazepine concentrations and increase dosage as clinically required.

refs.quote: CYP3A4 inducers can increase the rate of Tegretol metabolism.

value.effect: Carbamazepine strongly induces CYP3A4 and UGT, substantially reducing circulating levels of estrogen and progestin, leading to contraceptive failure.
value.management: Recommend alternative non-hormonal contraception (e.g. copper IUD) or dual barrier methods.

refs.quote: Tegretol is a potent inducer of hepatic 3A4 and is also known to be an inducer of CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8/9/19, and may therefore reduce plasma concentrations of co-medications mainly metabolized by CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8/9/19, and 3A4, through induction of their metabolism.
CYP3A4 inhibitors inhibit Tegretol metabolism and can thus increase plasma carbamazepine levels.
